fusions.name: Flung Disc
fusions.desc: Throws a flat disc that deals 16 damage and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rim Strike
fusions.desc: Swings the rim in a tight arc, dealing 5 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Interposed Palm
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Up
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
